policy_approval: UNRESOLVED for formula, rounding and tie break
scope: Additive synthetic approved-snapshot arithmetic inputs; no live server or product-policy approval. Existing oracle.json and policy-expectations.json remain unchanged.
expected_value_origin: Literal hand calculations recorded without invoking the production scoring engine. Current-contract assumptions were read from the production owner; this is not an independent policy oracle.
current_contract_assumption: Per-item max(0,min(100,round(100-5*absolute_delta))), then round(weighted mean of integer item scores). Positive half values round upward. Ranking: descending score, ascending weighted absolute delta, ascending exact UUID.

cases.counterexample: Rounding only after averaging raw item scores yields round(333.75/3.5)=95 instead of 96. Ties-to-even yields item score 92 instead of 93.
Truncation or ties-to-even at the final weighted mean returns 92. All item scores are already integers.

Removing the lower clamp yields -5; overwriting large evidence with zero loses the literal delta 21. Valid absolute deltas cannot exercise a raw score above 100, so the upper endpoint is checked without claiming upper-clamp branch coverage.
UUID-first, input-order or unweighted-absolute-mean ties choose UUID1; the observed weighted-delta rule chooses UUID2.
Clamping an invalid negative absolute delta into a superficially valid score of 100 must not replace evidence validation.

evidence_limit: Real decoder, adapter, scoring engine and completion payload are exercised using synthetic DTOs. This does not establish authenticated DB persistence, preview UI, device behavior or an approved formula.
